name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Prince goes with exactly one of Matilda, 10 coins, or 12 coins.
Either Aldric goes with 6 coins, or Wulfric goes with Sheriff — but not both.
Baron goes with none of Aldric, Wulfric, or 12 coins.
Between Bishop and Sheriff, one goes with Beatrix and the other with Matilda.
Either Beatrix goes with Bishop or Earl goes with Beatrix.
Beatrix's levy is at least 8 coins more than the artisan serving the Baron.
